15.t: Working with data: one gene, one protein
q: State the activity for people with two mutant versions.
Describe the effect of having one mutant version.
Explain how changing one amino acid can stop an enzyme working.
The new amino acid can change how the protein folds, so the active site changes shape and the substrate no longer fits.
The error bars show the spread. Explain what they tell us about the first two groups.
The bars do not overlap (92-108 vs 43-61), so the difference is probably real, not chance.
